title: pvNrrdReader
body:
## pvNrrdReader

Reads NRRD images (.nrrd, or a detached .nhdr header with its data file or files) into uniform image data, taking dimensions, type and spacing from the header. vtkNrrdReader reads raw, ascii (also spelled txt or text) and gzip-compressed (gzip or gz) data; hex and bzip2 encodings are rejected with 'Unsupported encoding'. A detached header may name several data files only when each holds one 2-D slice of a 3-D volume. DataVOI loads a sub-box of a large volume.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Re-save hex or bzip2 encoded NRRD files as raw or gzip before reading; the ParaView help text that calls ascii unsupported is out of date.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `NrrdReader`. Identity: `sources/NrrdReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DataVOI` | The data volume of interest (VOI). The VOI is a sub-extent of the data that you want loaded. Setting a VOI is useful when reading from a large data set and you are only interested in a small portion of the data. If left containing all 0's, then the reader will load in the entire data set. | `{"items":{"type":"integer"},"maxItems":6,"minItems":6,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1,1,1,1]` |
| `FileName` | The name of the file to read (or the meta data file that will point to the actual file). Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvNrrdReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
